user.title: Create a wallet
user.description: Configure a wallet with market valors valued via Yahoo Finance.

data.base_currency: Base currency (wallet total is shown in this currency)
data.invested_amount: Invested amount (optional, in the base currency; enables profit tracking)

valor.title: Add a valor
valor.description: Add a market valor to this wallet. Use Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. AAPL, VWAGY, BTC-USD, or an ETF like VWCE.DE.

data.target_share: Target share (%; optional — percent of the wallet this valor should hold; enables the deviation sensor)
data.add_another: Add another valor after this one

error.invalid_symbol: Please enter a valid Yahoo Finance symbol.
error.symbol_exists: This symbol is already in the wallet.
error.target_sum_exceeded: The sum of target shares would exceed 100%.
